statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations
The patient presents with episodes of dizziness
The symptoms are concerning for arrhythmia
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The service is to capture continuous rhythm data and correlate symptomatic events with potential cardiac dysrhythmias
The diagnosis codes are I34.0, R00.2, R42
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
